summary: Completed comprehensive full-system test of Aurora F&B ERP v0.3.0. Tested all 8 portals (Owner, Executive, Outlet, Procurement, Inventory, Finance, HR, Admin) + Public Website + Loyalty Portal. Frontend working excellently with 98.4% success rate (60/61 tests passed). All major features functional including new Cashier Loyalty Points Entry system and phone login. Navigation IA cleanup successfully verified across all portals.

minor_bugs.issue: Returns 405 Method Not Allowed instead of 201 Created
minor_bugs.impact: Cannot create new daily sales records via API POST. Frontend form works but submission fails.
minor_bugs.workaround: Frontend may be using different endpoint or method

endpoint_path_issues.issue: Backend test used wrong paths: /api/procurement/pr (should be /prs), /api/procurement/po (should be /pos), /api/procurement/gr (should be /grs)
endpoint_path_issues.impact: Test failures due to path mismatch, not actual backend failures
endpoint_path_issues.note: Frontend uses correct paths and works properly

endpoint_path_issues.issue: Backend test used /api/cms/* but actual endpoints are /api/admin/cms/*
endpoint_path_issues.impact: Test failures due to path mismatch, not actual backend failures
endpoint_path_issues.note: Frontend uses correct paths and works properly

validation_errors.issue: Return 422 validation error: 'period' query parameter required
validation_errors.impact: Expected behavior - reports need period parameter
validation_errors.note: This is correct validation, not a bug

design_issues.issue: 'Torado Rewards' link not visible in public website header
design_issues.impact: Users cannot easily discover loyalty program from public website
design_issues.workaround: Users can access loyalty portal via direct URL /loyalty/login
